facts.fact: Droit Medias Finance reports Cameroon Angels Network invested FCFA 21.5 million in Reasy, an Africa-China cross-border payments and logistics fintech, an investment finalised in the last quarter of 2024; the source does not say where Reasy is based.
The investor, Cameroon Angels Network, is a Cameroonian business angel group and called this its largest operation to date at FCFA 21.5 million in Reasy, finalised in the last quarter of 2024.
